headline: Galliano Met 🍂 EXHIBITION Cancelled 🚫 After BACKLASH 😱
text:
John Galliano 🧥 just DROPPED 💣 the bomb 💥 on his own Met 🏛️ exhibition 🍾 after it got COOKED 🍳 by massive backlash 😤 over his past conviction ⚖️ for antisemitic remarks 🗣️!! The British 👑 designer 🧵 who was SACKED 🗑️ from Dior in 2011 🗓️ and found guilty 🧑‍⚖️ of abusing a Jewish 🕍 curator 🖼️ in a Paris 🍷 restaurant 🪑 has now pulled the plug 🔌 on John Galliano Horizons 🌅 that was set to open in May 2027 📅!! After much reflection 🤔 and discussion 🗣️ with the Met 🏛️ and all those involved 🤝 he decided with great sadness 😢 that it is best the exhibition not take place at this time ⏰!! Bro was down bad 😔 after the court heard he hurled racist insults 🗣️ at her South Asian friend 🌏 and in a separate incident declared love for Hitler 🖐️!! His lawyer at the time blamed it on work related stress 😓 and multiple addictions 💊 but now Galliano says he remains fully accountable 📋 for the pain caused by his words 🗣️ especially to the Jewish 🕍 and Asian communities 🧘‍♀️ and he is deeply sorry 🙇!!

Galliano 🧥 stressed that meaningful atonement 🙏 is not achieved through an exhibition 🖼️ or institutional recognition 🏆 or a single public gesture 🙌 but is a continuing responsibility 📈 demonstrated through listening 👂 learning 📖 and one's conduct over time ⏳!! He added he did not want to distract 🚫 from the remarkable work ✨ of the Met's Costume Institute 👗 and recognised that an exhibition honouring his work would be painful 😣 for some people 👥!! The fashion icon also noted his 15 years of sobriety 🧘 and recovery from alcoholism 🍷 and addiction 💉 while Anna Wintour 👠 pictured with him in January 📸 said he retained her full support 🤝!! As well as being the focus of the exhibition the whole thing was gonna theme the next Met Gala 🎉 set for 3 May 🗓️ which happens to coincide with Yom HaShoah 🕯️ Holocaust Remembrance Day!!

Vogue global editorial director Anna Wintour 👠 who is a trustee of the Met 🏛️ and co chair of the Met Gala 🎟️ gave her support to Galliano on Monday saying his decision that the exhibition devoted to his work should not take place at this time is very courageous 🦸 and a measure of the man he is now 🧔!! She believes this is the right decision ✅ and both he and the Museum have her full support 🙌!! Others had previously voiced their opposition 🚫 to the Met's plan to commemorate Galliano with Julie Menin speaker of New York City Council 🗣️ saying after numerous meetings she is pleased they agreed not to honour him because at this rising time of antisemitism it served as a gut punch 👊 to the Jewish community 🕍!!

Jonathan Greenblatt 🕵️ chief executive of the Anti Defamation League 🛡️ which aims to counter antisemitism said that with antisemitism at crisis levels 📈 honouring Galliano would be misguided 🧭!! Even Galliano ultimately recognised what the Met should have done from the start and this was the wrong move at the wrong moment because timing matters ⏰!! Galliano is still regarded by some as one of the greatest fashion designers 🧥 and he returned to the industry after his conviction serving as creative director of Margiela for a decade until 2024 📆!! The designer left Maison Margiela after 10 years 🕒 and was previously sacked by the fashion label 🏷️ in that dramatic fall from grace 😔 that still haunts the timeline to this day 📜!!
